sre-oncall: Alert — external scanner flagged a public paste that contains an auth token we use with FastEdge (edge proxy). Vendor opened a support thread and flagged it as accidental debug dump. Please coordinate.
vendor-fastedge-support: Confirmed. We found a rollback that included a debug dump with tokens (internal ref FE-873). We revoked the gist and are investigating commit history: https://gist.github.com/redacted
maya: Which tokens exactly? service-to-service, customer tokens, or onboarding test tokens?
vendor-fastedge-support: Service auth tokens used by FastEdge to authenticate calls into our staging/proxy endpoint. Not user PII. They could be used to proxy requests to our staging environment if not revoked.
liam: Immediate containment plan: 1) rotate all FastEdge-related tokens in SecretsManager 2) revoke previous access 3) block vendor CI -> infra until rotation confirmed. I'm starting rotation now.
liam: Command I'm running:
```
aws secretsmanager rotate-secret --secret-id /vendor/fastedge/proxy-token --rotation-lambda arn:aws:lambda:...:rotate
```
nora: I'll add temporary firewall rules to block known FastEdge egress IPs from our staging cluster until we see rotated creds.
alice: Legal: need vendor incident report + timeline within 24h. Also confirm no customer data was exfiltrated. Flag to compliance if any cross-border transfer involved.
maya: Also enable and collect audit logs: CloudTrail + KMS decrypt logs for the key alias used. @liam can you confirm KMS key alias and whether rotation is enabled?
liam: KMS alias is `alias/vendor-fastedge-proxy`. Rotation was disabled previously (oversight). Enabling rotation and will push policy update to limit decrypt to specific roles. Uploading change in 5m.
vendor-fastedge-support: We rotated tokens on our side and removed the public gist. We're doing a full commit scan and will provide root cause and remediation plan by EOD. We missed the secret in a debug branch.
devex: Contingency: prepping internal proxy fallback. If rotation isn't confirmed in 30m we'll cut traffic to backup proxy for low-risk requests to avoid disruption.
maya: Post-incident actions and owners: vendor-fastedge-support (root cause + vendor remediation), liam (rotate + audit evidence), maya (incident ticket + RBAC scope tightening), nora (network blocking rules). Required outputs: signed vendor report, CloudTrail/KMS logs export, proof of token rotation, updated RBAC matrix.
vendor-fastedge-support: Note — our CI secret-scan missed the pattern due to a custom token prefix. We'll update scanning rules and share results.
e:emoji s0: sre-oncall: Thanks everyone. Please post final confirmation when secrets rotated and CloudTrail shows no unexpected decrypts. Marking incident acknowledged :white_check_mark:
metadata_note: single slack thread as continuous string; messages in chronological order; no title field per agents.md
